description: Returns the meaning, payload schema, and recommended response for one Agent-visible event. The target may be supplied under any parameter name; event is preferred.

event.description: Push event name, such as "Page.loaded" or "Hitl.resumed".

eventCatalogRevision.description: Content revision of the complete Agent-visible event catalog.

category.description: Event category used for routing and interpretation.

severity.description: Event severity as defined by the event registry.

agentMeaning.description: What the event means for the Agent task state.

recommendedResponse.description: Action-independent response guidance for this event.

payloadSchema.description: Schema for the event payload carried in System.notification.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Directly observed failure fact; it must not infer an unobserved browser side effect.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
